Which reading should the revision specification and the ROADMAP adopt?
options: Option A — library landing: revise 706/710 to land Probe706.no_finite_carrier_sat and Probe710.not_finite_width_fmp as FormalSystem/ theorems; 720 then re-points citations to library names
